title: Detailed lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='55%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff9c4'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ffd54f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9800'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='halo' cx='50%' cy='55%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe082' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb300' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='57' r='42' fill='url(#halo)'/>

  <!-- hanging hook -->
  <path d='M50 4 C44 4 41 9 44 13' fill='none' stroke='#ffb300' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <rect x='47' y='13' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#ffb300'/>

  <!-- top cap -->
  <path d='M30 19 L70 19 L64 27 L36 27 Z' fill='#e0a020'/>
  <path d='M30 19 L70 19 L68 21 L32 21 Z' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <rect x='34' y='27' width='32' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#ffca28'/>

  <!-- glass body with glow -->
  <path d='M36 31 L64 31 L68 40 L68 72 L64 80 L36 80 L32 72 L32 40 Z' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- flame -->
  <path d='M50 44 C46 52 44 58 50 66 C56 58 54 52 50 44 Z' fill='#fffde7'/>
  <path d='M50 50 C48 55 47 59 50 63 C53 59 52 55 50 50 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- candle base inside -->
  <rect x='46' y='66' width='8' height='12' rx='2' fill='#ffe9a8'/>

  <!-- glass frame bars -->
  <rect x='47' y='31' width='6' height='49' fill='#ffb300' opacity='0.85'/>
  <rect x='32' y='38' width='36' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffca28' opacity='0.8'/>
  <rect x='32' y='68' width='36' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffca28' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- side bars -->
  <rect x='33' y='31' width='3' height='49' fill='#e0a020'/>
  <rect x='64' y='31' width='3' height='49' fill='#e0a020'/>

  <!-- glass edge highlights -->
  <rect x='36' y='36' width='2' height='38' fill='#fffde7' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- bottom cap -->
  <rect x='34' y='80' width='32' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#ffca28'/>
  <path d='M36 84 L64 84 L58 92 L42 92 Z' fill='#e0a020'/>
  <path d='M42 92 L58 92 L54 97 L46 97 Z' fill='#ffb300'/>
</svg>
